title: 18-24 year olds: living with an unmarried partner vs a spouse (percent)

source.name: Census Bureau data reported via Bloomberg: Modern Love: Cohabitation on the Rise
source.publisher: U.S. Census Bureau (American Community Survey, reported by Bloomberg)

notes: Among adults aged 18-24, Census data show 9% living with an unmarried partner versus 7% living with a spouse -- the first time cohabitation has outnumbered marriage for this age group.
